summary: Twenty One Capital, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on August 31, 2026 disclosing that CEO Raphael Zagury presented at the Bitcoin Asia 2026 conference on August 27, 2026 regarding the Bitcoin mining industry. The presentation and transcript were furnished as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report of a public-company executive speaking engagement, not a special situation; watch only for any subsequent corporate-action filing, none of which is indicated here.
